verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a CRM, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows standard reporting ('performance details for agents, teams and lead sources'), smart lists and automation, but nothing about AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. Non-AI reporting and automation are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
